title: Verify: BootScene preload and fallback unit tests
summary: Unit tests for BootScene preload with Phaser mocked
description: Extend the Phaser mock like game/frontend/tests/bootSceneEffects.test.ts with load.image, load.spritesheet and load.on fakes; mock @game/engine/preload planPreload.
acceptance_criteria: preload test asserts load.image and load.spritesheet are called for planned entries
loaderror test asserts the key is recorded and the fallback texture is generated
technical_constraints: Plan fixture mirrors PreloadPlan type from game/src/engine/preload.ts

steps.action: Mock planPreload to return one image entry and one spritesheet entry; call new BootScene().preload() with fake load; assert load.image and load.spritesheet called with the entry ids and '/assets/' urls.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootScenePreload.test.ts -t queues

steps.action: Capture the handler passed to load.on('loaderror'), invoke it with {key:'a'}, and assert the scene marks 'a' failed and that create() generates the fallback texture.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootScenePreload.test.ts -t loaderror
